camera.source: measured by template matching the two tree masses against frame 10 (the hand-held camera tilts up about 70 px over frames 0-9, then bobs); 1-2-1 smoothed, sideways shake at 0.6

no_cel: SAM masked the storm cloud with the funnel, so the cel erased the cloud scenery
planes_note: Sky and ground are at the character's depth (z 2): the camera only tilts and shakes in this shot, and a tilt moves near and far things by the same amount, as the trees, the pole and the funnel do in the measurements. Clouds sit just above the cloud base the funnel hangs from (y about 80 at frame 10), lowered 10 px from before so they stay in frame through the camera's upward bobs.
